Sobre a oportunidade: Esta vaga é para quem gosta de liderar pelo exemplo e construir sistemas que saem do PowerPoint para operar no mundo real. A GETTER procura um líder técnico com profundidade suficiente para discutir arquitetura, orientar trade-offs, acelerar execução entre squads e manter padrão de entrega num projeto que mistura IA, visão computacional, integrações, produto operacional em contexto industrial crítico e de escala global. Aqui, liderança técnica significa entrar nos problemas, discutir arquitetura, acelerar execução e elevar o padrão do sistema. O que você vai construir: direção técnica do projeto; padrões de integração; critérios de qualidade; cadência entre pesquisa, engenharia e produto. Responsabilidades-chave: priorizar risco técnico; revisar arquitetura; orientar times; apoiar decisões de build/buy; garantir consistência entre componentes. Sucesso 30/90/180d: 30d mapear riscos e dependências; 90d estabilizar fluxo técnico e previsibilidade das entregas ; 180d reduzir retrabalho e elevar previsibilidade de entrega. Must-have: liderança hands‑on; arquitetura; inglês; integração; qualidade de software ; comunicação com múltiplos perfis. Nice-to-have: IA industrial; Digital Twin; cloud; sistemas distribuídos. Stack: arquitetura de sistemas, APIs, mensageria, cloud, observabilidade. Screening questions: Já liderou squad técnico multidisciplinar? Continua confortável codando/revisando com profundidade? Já tomou decisões de arquitetura em ambiente com dados/IA? Aceita presencial em Manaus? Teste curto: Um case realista de arquitetura envolvendo IA, integrações e operação industrial. Avaliamos capacidade de estruturar sistemas, discutir trade‑offs e transformar ambição técnica em execução pragmática. Fluxo/SLA/pessoas: padrão; painel final com liderança executiva + produto + arquitetura. Contrato PJ R$ 12k–17k + upside conforme senioridade, evolução e impacto no projeto. O tipo de desafio que você vai enfrentar Sistemas operando em tempo real em ambiente industrial Integração entre IA, visão computacional, dashboards e operação Arquitetura para ambientes críticos e conectividade imperfeita Evolução contínua de modelos e produto em operação viva Construção de software orientado a impacto físico e operacional A GETTER S.A. é uma empresa brasileira de IA industrial em crescimento acelerado, especializada em elevar performance, qualidade e segurança por meio de visão computacional, IA generativa e automação de processos. Em seu portfólio público, a empresa apresenta o SAFETY, focado em segurança e ergonomia com alertas e dashboards; o PLUS, focado em contagem de produção, inspeção de qualidade e aumento de produtividade via IA; e o Menthor, assistente virtual treinado com os dados reais da operação e integrado a documentos, ERP e bancos de dados. A proposta da GETTER é transformar dados operacionais em consciência, decisão e ação no mundo físico. Sobre o Projeto O escopo envolve visão computacional, modelos de IA, Digital Twin 3D, LLMs, geração automática de instruções, modelos preditivos, dashboards operacionais e integrações com o ecossistema fabril. A oportunidade é especialmente aderente para pessoas que gostam de construir software e IA conectados ao mundo físico, com impacto direto em produtividade, segurança, decisão operacional e melhoria contínua. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Confira a vaga para Gerente de TI em manaus. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world’s top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe. JOB SUMMARY As a site IT manager you will manage the information services function for one or more locations. Responsible to deliver IT services through effective resource management and bridging communications between IT, operations/business units and external customers. Will have ownership for the delivery of IT services that support complex business operations by demonstrating effective leadership for those involved in the development, design, optimization and delivery of information service solutions. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES Drive the provision of a high quality IT service across all operational and support areas Accountability for the overall provision of an end-to-end IT service across agreed services Accountability for driving the IT service agenda and implementing IT service improvements across the business Build and maintain strong relationships directly with operations, the business units and external customers Communicate and manage business unit and operational IT service issues Collaborate with internal IT teams to effectively deliver services to end users Identify, track and manage key operational risks to the service, coordinating with the business, IT and Operational Risk; focus on business continuity, IT audit requirements and software compliance Drive metrics management and performance of IT support and services with a data-driven continuous improvement approach Participate in the exchange of ideas and information across the global IT organization to help drive standardization and sharing of best practices Collaborate with and understand the needs of internal/external customers from a business process and product perspective to help drive key IT solutions for operational efficiencies Accurately and timely deliver monthly reporting to the business regarding IT service performance, including service trends, improvement activity and SLA attainment Provide a reliable and stable service that meets customer needs and is sustainable Build a clear understanding of the service requirements of the business Engage with project delivery teams to ensure site requirements are embedded in project plans supporting agreed service levels and expected capabilities Support the incident management process by clearly articulating business impact during major incidents and driving completion of corrective actions and problem management activities Drive awareness of change management activity for high-category services ensuring business impact is understood and risks to processing are highlighted Select, develop, and evaluate personnel to ensure efficient operation of the IT function Coordinate work schedules, priorities, and performance management of IT personnel Handle financial forecasting and cost management of the site IT function Demonstrate commitment to customer service; anticipate, meet and exceed expectations by solving problems quickly and effectively, making customer issues a priority Work effectively under pressure with constantly changing priorities and deadlines Understand and embrace the global IT strategic direction Adhere to all safety and health rules and regulations associated with this position and as directed by superior Enforce and follow all procedures and policies within IT and the company Participate in internal audit programs and drive non‑compliance issues to conclusion Project Management as required May perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned JOB QUALIFICATIONS KNOWLEDGE REQUIREMENTS Demonstrated leadership and resource management experience Significant experience working with ITIL processes Interpersonal skills in working with the customer, management and technical teams in a “self‑starter” role Excellent written and verbal communication skills Effective presentation skills Strong attention to detail Experience delivering SAP services and Manufacturing Execution Systems in a working environment preferred EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS Bachelor’s Degree preferred Minimum of 5 years work‑related experience required in IT or related discipline Minimum of 2 years management experience required Lean Six Sigma qualification preferred Or an equivalent combination of education, training or experience WORKING CONDITIONS Regular business hours + on call; some additional hours may be required Travel requirements: Domestic and/or International, up to 20% Climate-controlled office environment during normal business hours PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS Sitting Walking Standing Bending/Squatting/Stooping Reaching Balancing Twisting Crawling Hands in water Kneeling Data Entry/Typing Unusual hearing or vision demands: None specified Employees should not attempt to lift, pull or push a load in excess of 50 lbs. without assistance; care should be taken when lifting, pushing or pulling in an awkward position Jabil, including its subsidiaries, is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Accessibility Accommodation If you are a qualified individual with a disability, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access Jabil.com/Careers site as a result of your disability. You can request a reasonable accommodation by sending an e‑mail to with the nature of your request and contact information. Please do not direct any other general employment related questions to this e‑mail. Please note that only those inquiries concerning a request for reasonable accommodation will be responded to. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Analista De Planejamento Financeiro Sênior
vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Analista De Planejamento Financeiro Sênior em rio branco. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Planejamento Financeiro Sênior para integrar o time de uma empresa de que presta serviço de BPO Financeiro, consultoria e serviços de CFO Service nos EUA, atuando como peça-chave na gestão financeira estratégica de uma carteira de clientes de diferentes portes, segmentos e níveis de maturidade. Este profissional será responsável por conduzir, de forma autônoma e estruturada, processos de planejamento, orçamento, análise de desempenho e geração de insights financeiros para múltiplas empresas simultaneamente, atuando como referência técnica e parceiro estratégico dos sócios e gestores dos clientes atendidos. Planejamento e Orçamento Conduzir o processo de orçamento anual (budget) , revisões orçamentárias (forecast) e planejamento de longo prazo das empresas da carteira. Estruturar e manter modelos financeiros de DRE gerencial, fluxo de caixa projetado, balanço patrimonial e análise de cenários (base, otimista, conservador). Apoiar a definição de metas, KPIs financeiros e operacionais alinhados às estratégias de cada cliente Análise de Desempenho e Reporting Elaborar relatórios gerenciais mensais (Management Reports) com análise de variação realizado vs. orçado, drivers de resultado e recomendações de melhoria. Construir e manter dashboards financeiros e painéis de indicadores (KPIs) para acompanhamento contínuo da performance dos clientes. Gestão Financeira Multiempresa Atuar como business partner de múltiplos clientes simultaneamente, organizando agenda, prazos, entregas e priorizações de forma independente. Conduzir reuniões de resultado com sócios, diretores e gestores das empresas atendidas, traduzindo números em recomendações claras e acionáveis. Identificar gargalos, riscos financeiros e oportunidades de melhoria nas operações dos clientes. Processos, Controle e Melhoria Contínua Padronizar e otimizar processos de planejamento financeiro dentro da carteira atendida, propondo melhorias contínuas. Apoiar a estruturação de plano de contas gerencial , centros de custo e rateios que reflitam corretamente a operação de cada cliente. Garantir a integridade, consistência e qualidade das informações financeiras geradas, atuando próximo às áreas de contabilidade, contas a pagar/receber e tesouraria. Qualificações Requisitos Obrigatórios Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência comprovada em Planejamento Financeiro, FP&A, Controladoria ou Consultoria Financeira. Formação superior completa em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia, Engenharia, Finanças ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação, MBA ou certificações em Finanças, Controladoria, FP&A, CFA, CGMA ou equivalentes. Experiência prática com construção de orçamento, forecast, DRE gerencial e fluxo de caixa projetado . Domínio avançado de Excel (modelagem financeira, fórmulas complexas, tabelas dinâmicas, Power Query). Vivência em gestão simultânea de múltiplas empresas, clientes ou unidades de negócio — experiência em BPO Financeiro, consultoria, family office, holding ou auditoria é altamente desejável. Capacidade comprovada de trabalhar de forma autônoma , gerenciando o próprio tempo, prioridades e entregas em ambiente 100% remoto. Inglês nível avançado/ fluente (usará inglês no dia a dia). Perfil Compartimental (o que esperamos de você) Autonomia e protagonismo: capacidade de conduzir o trabalho de ponta a ponta com mínima supervisão, propondo soluções em vez de apenas reportar problemas. Pensamento analítico e crítico: habilidade de interpretar números, questionar premissas, identificar inconsistências e enxergar a história por trás dos dados. Resolução de problemas: postura proativa para destravar entregas, lidar com ambiguidade e propor caminhos práticos diante de cenários complexos. Organização e disciplina: capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas demandas, prazos e clientes simultaneamente sem perder qualidade ou prazo. Comunicação clara e objetiva: habilidade de traduzir análises técnicas em mensagens compreensíveis para sócios e gestores de diferentes níveis. Postura consultiva: atuação como parceiro estratégico do cliente, e não apenas como executor de relatórios. Maturidade profissional e ética: discrição no trato com informações sensíveis e confidenciais. Diferenciais Conhecimento em ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Looker Studio, Tableau). Conhecimento em ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para Technical Support Engineer (Analytics Focused) em manaus. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Our client is a Business Intelligence platform enabling customers to connect multiple data sources (e.g., Excel, SQL) into a unified environment, build interactive dashboards, apply formulas, and customize via plugins, scripts, and embedding. The product supports both SaaS and on-prem deployments. Support is organized into 4 pods: Analytics, DevEx, Data, and Infra. Our Technical Support team spans the globe and has recently begun a major transformation effort to move to a SWARM model for our tools, processes, and organizational structure. This shift focuses on driving a collaborative, rewarding environment that measures value creation and team playing. Our team is aligned directly with our Product and Engineering teams through a robust Subject Matter Expert program. Responsibilities Investigate technical problems and diagnose root causes in Linux and Windows servers Develop, design, and propose solutions to meet the technological and business needs of customers (e.g., workarounds for product issues and additional features) Manage critical issues that impact customers’ business Work with R&D and Product teams to meet customer requirements and improve our product Present complex technical information about the product to the customers Take part in the creation and maintenance of our knowledge-based and community Work with Linux shell, RestAPI, Web applications troubleshooting, application installations, identifying process improvements, debugging, comprehending technical documents Work Hours US East business hours. Main Skills (What You’ve Already Accomplished...So Far) You already experienced with supporting complex product infrastructure and applications You have experience with troubleshooting web applications You have experience with databases such as MS SQL, MySQL, Oracle etc, SQL scripting at least at basic level You already worked with ETL and BI tools such as Microsoft Power BI, Talend, SSRS, BusinessObjects, Cognos etc OR you are able to write and understand complex formulas You have experience working with logs, and various monitoring tools such as Grafana, New Relic, Kibana You are familiar with Linux You have experience in communication with English-speaking customers Nice to have Experience with virtualization and cloud services (AWS, vSphere) Experience with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB or Hadoop Experience with RestAPI Networking knowledges Technical Support Engineer (Analytics Focused) Manaus, BR #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Sales Manager, Laparoscopy Systems
vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Sales Manager, Laparoscopy Systems em manaus. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About the Company Reach Surgical, a Genesis Medtech Company, is a leading minimally‑invasive surgical device manufacturer and supplier, committed to serving high‑quality products to healthcare practitioners and patients worldwide. We deliver advanced technology and cost‑effective minimally‑invasive surgical products to medical institutions and provide patients with reliable and economical treatment solutions. About the Role We are looking for a high‑performing Sales Manager to spearhead regional sales management, drive business growth, and accelerate the expansion of Laparoscopic products for Brazil. Responsibilities Sales Management of Laparoscopic products within the assigned geographic area and markets to achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue targets. Conduct market research, including customers and competitors’ activities, and formulate and execute market development strategies. Develop and build long‑lasting relationships with stakeholders, including distributors and healthcare professionals, and obtain feedback on our products for internal stakeholders. Development and execution of sales plans: Define clear and measurable overseas sales goals, develop corresponding action plans, and execute them effectively to meet company objectives. Conduct detailed hospital and micro‑market analysis; maintain up‑to‑date market intelligence to understand industry trends and competitive landscapes. Formulate and implement effective competitive strategies based on insights into market dynamics and competitor activities. Support regional marketing activities, leverage internal and external resources efficiently, and enhance overall customer value. Maintain a deep understanding of regional market conditions; identify emerging opportunities and potential challenges to make informed and timely decisions. KOL (Key Opinion Leader) management: Establish and maintain a comprehensive overseas KOL information archive. Analyze the potential and specific needs of KOLs to develop targeted engagement plans. Strategically allocate resources to build, strengthen, and sustain long‑term cooperative relationships with KOLs. Distributor management: Identify, evaluate, and onboard distributors that meet company criteria and strategic alignment. Provide motivation, ongoing support, and training to ensure distributors adhere to company standards and deliver expected outcomes. Demonstrate strong communication and distributor management skills; conduct regular performance reviews and offer actionable feedback to maintain an effective and healthy distribution network. Qualifications and Requirements Bachelor's degree or higher in Business Management, Marketing, Trade, Life Sciences, Clinical Sciences or a related field. Minimum 3 years of experience in international sales or business development, preferably in the laparoscopic industry. Proficiency in English is required. Strong sales and negotiation skills. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with experience in cross‑cultural communication. Location: Manaus, Amazonas, Brazil #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Ai Benchmark Engineer (Planning/Operations) - 75063
vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para Ai Benchmark Engineer (Planning/Operations) - 75063 em manaus. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L. Role Overview We are looking for AI Benchmark Engineers specializing in planning and operations to design and build complex, multi-agent benchmark tasks that simulate real-world planning, scheduling, and operational decision‑making scenarios. This role focuses on creating constraint‑rich problems that evaluate multi‑agent reasoning, decomposition, and optimization capabilities in realistic environments. What does day‑to‑day life look like? Design and develop multi‑agent benchmark tasks involving: Planning, scheduling, and resource allocation Operational decision‑making (project management, logistics, incident response, capacity planning) Create constraint‑rich problem statements with multiple interacting variables Develop verification scripts to evaluate: Feasibility (all constraints satisfied) Completeness (all requirements addressed) Optimality (efficient solutions) Build decomposition strategies: Split tasks across specialized sub‑agents (resource‑based, constraint‑based, conflict resolution, optimization) Model real‑world operational scenarios with dependencies, timelines, and resource constraints Collaborate on improving task quality, coverage, and evaluation rigor Requirements 5+ years of experience in operations, project management, logistics, or supply chain Strong ability to formalize constraints, dependencies, and scheduling logic Proficiency in Python for building verification and validation scripts Strong structured problem‑solving and decomposition skills Clear and precise technical writing skills Experience with AI coding benchmarks (e.g., SWE‑bench, Terminal‑bench) Hands‑on experience with Docker (Dockerfiles, image builds, debugging) Nice to have Experience with optimization techniques (linear programming, constraint satisfaction, scheduling algorithms) Background in operations research Experience with simulation or modeling tools Knowledge of AI planning systems or automated reasoning Perks of Freelancing With Turing Work in a fully remote environment. Opportunity to work on cutting‑edge AI projects with leading LLM companies. Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST. Engagement Type: Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave). Duration of Contract: 4 weeks (adjustable based on engagement). Evaluation Process Take home assessment #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Assistente De Controle De Inventário
vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Assistente De Controle De Inventário em manaus. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

A Dropservice é a base por trás do crescimento de um ecossistema de marcas. Conectamos pessoas, processos e dados para que nossas marcas cresçam com clareza, eficiência e impacto em grandes marketplaces, como Amazon e TikTok Shop. Estamos buscando um(a) Assistente de Controle de Inventário para cuidar do fluxo de estoque das marcas (do pedido na fábrica até a chegada na Amazon), garantindo organização, informação atualizada e zero surpresa. Se você é organizado(a), gosta de planilhas, presta atenção em detalhes e gosta de ver tudo sob controle, essa vaga pode ser para você. Principais responsabilidades Criar e atualizar planilhas de ordens de compra para fábricas e controle interno. Atualizar a planilha de estoque. Acompanhar a movimentação AWD → FBA na Amazon e realizar transferências quando necessário. Checar mensalmente os limites de capacidade na Amazon por marca e país e sinalizar necessidade de aumento. Preparar o plano de envio de cada ordem de compra, alinhado às necessidades de chegada na Amazon. Criar envios na Amazon, gerar etiquetas, enviar às fábricas e atualizar códigos de rastreamento. Controlar o estoque de materiais de produção (garrafas, paper tubes, caixas etc.). Registrar dados de envios em planilhas (datas, valores, links, status) e acompanhar a chegada dos produtos na Amazon. Atualizar ClickUp a cada mudança de status dos envios. Lançar as ordens de compra no Sellerboard, com itens e custos, para manter o custo dos produtos atualizado. Requisitos essenciais Experiência com rotinas administrativas e/ou controle de estoque/inventário. Facilidade com Excel/Google Sheets (nível intermediário para controle e atualização de dados). Organização, atenção a detalhes e disciplina para seguir processos e checklists. Capacidade de trabalhar com várias planilhas e sistemas ao mesmo tempo, sem se perder. Boa comunicação escrita para alinhar informações com o time. Disponibilidade para atuar como PJ, 100% remoto, em período integral. Diferenciais Experiência com e-commerce ou marketplaces (ex.: Amazon). Familiaridade com ferramentas como ClickUp e Sellerboard. Modelo de trabalho Contratação: PJ Local: 100% remoto Faixa salarial: R$2000,00 a R$2500,00 #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: MÉDICO DO TRABALHO (INCLUSIVA PARA PESSOAS COM DEFICIÊNCIA) - BOA VISTA/RR
vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando MÉDICO DO TRABALHO (INCLUSIVA PARA PESSOAS COM DEFICIÊNCIA) - BOA VISTA/RR em boa vista. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Descrição da vaga Na CASSI somos movidos pelo propósito que é o de “Cuidar do participante em todas as fases da sua vida”, ainda que façamos parte de uma equipe de atividade meio ou fim, nosso propósito é único e sempre voltado ao participante da CASSI. Por isso acreditamos que o Médico do Trabalho não é somente um cargo, mas participa ativamente da construção de estratégias para uma CASSI cada dia melhor. Precisamos de pessoas que estejam dispostas a aprender e multiplicar conhecimento, avaliar e trocar ideias sobre o processo com a ótica de que podemos estar em constantes mudanças e melhorias. Valorizamos a diversidade e a inclusão! Todas as nossas vagas são abertas a pessoas de todos os perfis, incluindo pessoas com deficiência (PcD), pessoas negras, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+, 50+, entre outros grupos minorizados. Caso você precise de algum recurso ou adaptação para participar do processo seletivo ou exercer suas atividades, por favor, informe no campo “Descrição das atividades”. Estamos comprometidos em oferecer um ambiente acessível e acolhedor para todos. Responsabilidades e atribuições Acompanhar e avaliar a execução do PCMSO dos funcionários BB e CASSI, bem como garantir as informações relativas aos exames e atividades relacionadas à Saúde do Trabalhador. Regularizar licença‑saúde de funcionários BB e CASSI. Fornecer subsídio médico aos médicos examinadores e avaliar sistematicamente os serviços. Auxiliar na implantação e desenvolvimento de programas de saúde do BB e CASSI. Acompanhar afastamentos e absenteísmo dos funcionários BB e CASSI. Apoiar na organização e execução de ações educativas e preventivas em saúde ocupacional. Observar as condições de higiene e orientar na correção de possíveis falhas. Apoiar na elaboração e manutenção do Programa de Gerenciamento de Riscos - PGR da CASSI. Realizar consultas médicas de acompanhamento da saúde do trabalhador. Ser, quando indicado pela CASSI, o responsável técnico em sua área de atribuição, perante órgãos diversos. Emitir parecer técnico, baseado na análise de documentos e dados de prontuários. Realizar atendimento de urgência e emergência, sempre que necessário, no âmbito da CLINICASSI. Prestar ou solicitar informações aos médicos do SESMT do Banco do Brasil para subsidiar decisões médicas. Providenciar a notificação compulsória quando diagnosticar agravo ou doença que requeiram o procedimento. Assinar o PCMSO como Responsável local da Unidade e da(s) CliniCASSI(s). (exceto DF). ATRIBUIÇÕES: Executar nas Unidades os exames de saúde ocupacional de acordo com o previsto no Programa de Controle Médico de Saúde Ocupacional (PCMSO) do BB e da CASSI de acordo com normas e diretrizes da Instituição, relacionadas à qualidade no atendimento e o cumprimento de metas. Regularizar licença‑saúde de funcionários do BB e da CASSI, de acordo com normas e diretrizes estabelecidas, para diagnóstico precoce de enfermidades ocupacionais, acompanhamento dos níveis de absenteísmo e retorno ao trabalho. Prestar atendimento e acompanhar casos suspeitos de doença ocupacional, conforme protocolo de saúde ocupacional, visando diminuir as incidências e a melhoria das condições de saúde do trabalhador. Colaborar na elaboração de conteúdo específico e execução de ações educativas em saúde ocupacional, de acordo com o programa de saúde do trabalhador, objetivando uma relação mais saudável com o trabalho e consequente melhoria da qualidade de vida do funcionário. Avaliar nível de comprometimento de quadro de saúde de funcionário e o impacto deste na execução de atividades laborais com a finalidade de definir/recomendar necessidade de afastamentos para fins de recuperação e tratamento adequados. Realizar caracterização de acidentes do trabalho e diagnóstico de doenças do trabalho de funcionários CASSI a partir de formulação de nexo causal de maneira apropriada procedendo o preenchimento de formulário de Comunicado de Acidente de Trabalho (MO‑FC– ), observando o fluxo Acidente do Trabalho (AN‑NR‑ ) para encaminhamento. Realizar acompanhamento de funcionários do BB e da CASSI afastados, objetivando qualificar o processo de recuperação de saúde e planos terapêuticos estabelecidos, assessorando na definição de recursos assistenciais a serem assumidos pela CASSI nas situações de doenças e acidentes de trabalho. Prestar assessoria e participar na capacitação de médicos credenciados que executam exames ocupacionais para empresas conveniadas objetivando a qualificação do serviço prestado. Elaborar e executar conjuntamente com equipe de saúde dos serviços de saúde e médicos assistentes relacionados, Plano de Reinserção Laboral, conforme estabelecido pela empresa, em funcionários da CASSI nos casos de afastados que retornam ao trabalho através de Programa de Reabilitação da Previdência Social. Acompanhar e participar, conjuntamente com equipe de saúde dos serviços de saúde e médicos assistentes relacionados, das ações de assistência em saúde do trabalhador relacionadas a programas do BB destinadas a funcionários do BB e da CASSI. Participar da produção qualificada de informações relativas ao perfil epidemiológico, aos exames de PCMSO e atividades em Saúde do Trabalhador do BB e da CASSI. Apoiar na elaboração e manutenção do PGR da CASSI. Preencher o documento de investigação da CAT para funcionários BB, conforme orientado em normativos do Convênio Saúde do Trabalhador, e encaminhar ao SESMT BB para investigação do Acidente. Avaliar o nexo causal de acidentes/doença do trabalho dos funcionários do Banco do Brasil, previamente a todos os procedimentos. Analisar os documentos e dados de prontuários para subsidiar a emissão de parecer técnico, a partir das instruções normativas pertinentes sobre questões relacionadas à assistência e regularização funcional a funcionários do BB e da CASSI. Requisitos e qualificações PRÉ‑REQUISITOS: Ensino Superior completo em Medicina. Registro no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM). Especialização em Medicina do Trabalho. Experiência na área de Saúde do Trabalhador Informações adicionais Salário R$ 9.117,48 após período de experiência Carga horária: 20 horas semanais Vaga 100% presencial BENEFÍCIOS: Cesta alimentação: R$ 498,48 Vale refeição/alimentação: R$ 875,82 Plano de saúde (opcional) Previdência Privada (opcional) Oferecemos licença maternidade de até 6 meses Licença paternidade de até 20 dias Auxílio creche Wellhub (antigo Gympass) OBSERVAÇÕES: Os benefícios podem variar de acordo com o modelo de contrato. As informações devem ser confirmadas durante a entrevista. O candidato tem a responsabilidade legal pelas informações registradas na inscrição, podendo a CASSI, a qualquer tempo durante a seleção, exigir documentação que comprove os requisitos obrigatórios da vaga. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Essa oportunidade está aberta à candidatura de todas as pessoas, independentemente de orientação sexual, acessibilidade social ou de qualquer outro fator. Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD's). Você não se identificou com essa vaga? Não se preocupe! Você ainda pode fazer parte do nosso time! Inscreva-se no nosso banco de talentos e assim que surgir uma oportunidade que tenha mais a ver com você, nós entraremos em contato! RESPONSIBILITIES AND ASSIGNMENTS Conduzir soluções técnicas para sistemas de utilidades industriais em obras de grande porte, incluindo vapor, água gelada, água quente, ar comprimido, gases industriais, vácuo e sistemas de refrigeração; Atuar na execução de projetos e soluções de utilidades industriais, com foco em confiabilidade operacional e alta demanda de produção; Dimensionar, especificar e selecionar equipamentos críticos de utilidades, como compressores de ar comprimido, chillers (cheillers), caldeiras, bombas, torres de resfriamento e trocadores de calor; Garantir atendimento às normas técnicas, requisitos de segurança, eficiência energética e performance operacional dos sistemas; Atuar em projetos industriais de grande porte, assegurando integração entre sistemas de utilidades e demais disciplinas da engenharia; Elaborar memoriais descritivos, especificações técnicas, listas de materiais e documentação de engenharia; Acompanhar execução em obra, incluindo montagem, instalação, testes, comissionamento e start‑up de sistemas industriais; Validar testes de desempenho de equipamentos e sistemas, como chillers e compressores, garantindo entrega conforme especificação de projeto; Investigar falhas operacionais e propor melhorias em sistemas de utilidades industriais; Interagir com equipes multidisciplinares (civil, elétrica, automação, processos e obras), fornecedores; Atuar como referência técnica em projetos de utilidades industriais de grande porte; Acompanhar medições, documentação técnica e relatórios de obra; REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS Superior Completo em Engenharia Mecânica (ter no mínimo 6 anos de formação); Desejável Pós Graduação em Gestão de Projetos ou Segurança do Trabalho ou relacionadas as Engenharias; Sólida experiência em engenharia mecânica aplicada a utilidades industriais em obras de grande porte; Vivência em projetos industriais complexos com sistemas de compressores, chillers (cheillers), caldeiras e redes de utilidades; Experiência em plantas industriais de médio e grande porte (indústria farmacêutica, alimentos, química, óleo e gás, data centers ou similares); Atuação em engenharia básica, detalhada, execução e comissionamento de utilidades industriais; Experiência com gestão técnica de equipamentos críticos e fornecedores; Excel avançado e domínio em MS Project; Desejável Inglês Intermediário; CREA Ativo; Familiaridade com normas técnicas aplicáveis (ABNT, ASHRAE, API, entre outras); Inglês técnico para leitura e elaboração de documentos técnicos; Buscamos profissionais com capacidade de orientação e interação com diferentes culturas, proatividade, pensamento analítico, flexibilidade e foco em resultados, sendo que a certificação PMI será considerada um diferencial. Vaga de caráter temporário, com previsão de duração de aproximadamente 12 meses, vinculada ao prazo estimado de execução da obra. Para candidatos internos, estejam cientes de que, em caso de aprovação no processo seletivo interno UP! para uma localidade diferente da atual, estarão sujeitos(as) às convenções e aos acordos coletivos vigentes na localidade de destino. Definição dos processos de teste para as versões desenvolvidas do sistema e features. Habilidade em gerenciar e priorizar bugs. Experiência em automação de testes e programação (Python, Java, Kotlin etc.). Habilidade em criação e manutenção de testes automatizados. O que será um diferencial Experiência como líder de teste, responsável por definição de estratégias e abordagens de teste. Experiência em automação de testes mobile (Android). Experiência com ferramentas de I.A aplicado ao contexto de QA. Experiência atuando como SDET. Experiência em desenvolvimento utilizando esteiras CI/CD (Jenkins, Docker, Git e outros). Experiência em testes de carga ou performance e ferramentas (Jmeter, Artillery, etc). Habilidades em frameworks de teste (Appium, Selenium etc.). Certificação em testes (ISTQB). vagas.title: K-Pop Influencers
vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para K-Pop Influencers em manaus. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

K-POP & K-Drama Influencer Growth Creator Powered by IZISURF About IZISURF IZISURF is building a next-generation creator growth ecosystem focused on K-POP, K-Drama, Korean entertainment, and global fan communities. Our mission is to help passionate creators transform their content into scalable global media brands through audience growth, AI-powered optimization, fan engagement strategies, and cross-platform expansion. We believe that the future of entertainment media belongs to creators who deeply understand fandom culture, digital storytelling, and internet trends. As Korean entertainment continues to influence global culture, we are creating an infrastructure that helps influencers grow faster, engage audiences more effectively, and unlock meaningful monetization opportunities. Unlike traditional influencer agencies, IZISURF operates as a creator growth partner. We actively work alongside creators to optimize content performance, identify viral opportunities, improve audience retention, and expand creator reach across multiple social media platforms. Our goal is not only to help creators gain followers, but to help them build long‑term digital brands with sustainable growth. Position Overview We are looking for highly creative, trend‑aware, and passionate K‑POP & K‑Drama Influencer Growth Creators who are excited about Korean entertainment culture and want to build a strong global online presence. This role is ideal for individuals who genuinely enjoy discussing K‑POP groups, idols, dramas, entertainment news, fan theories, comeback analysis, performances, concerts, and online fandom culture. Whether you are already an influencer or an emerging creator with strong potential, we are interested in working with people who can create authentic and engaging content that resonates with audiences worldwide. As part of IZISURF, creators will receive strategic support designed to accelerate growth. Our team helps creators improve audience engagement, optimize content formats, analyze performance metrics, and identify viral content opportunities. We work collaboratively with creators to develop sustainable content strategies rather than focusing only on short‑term trends. Responsibilities The selected creator will regularly produce engaging content related to K‑POP, K‑Dramas, Korean celebrities, entertainment culture, idol trends, music releases, and fan discussions. Content may include reactions, commentary, reviews, rankings, livestream discussions, entertainment analysis, short‑form videos, and community engagement activities. Creators will publish content across platforms such as TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, YouTube, X (Twitter), Threads, and other emerging media channels. The role requires staying highly informed about ongoing entertainment trends, comeback schedules, drama releases, viral online discussions, and fandom activities. In addition to content production, creators will collaborate closely with the IZISURF growth team to improve visibility and engagement. This includes reviewing analytics, refining content strategy, experimenting with new content formats, and participating in cross‑platform growth campaigns. We encourage creators to continuously evolve their personal brand while maintaining authenticity and strong audience connection. Creators may also participate in brand collaborations, entertainment campaigns, livestream events, fan engagement projects, and promotional activities related to Korean entertainment and digital culture. What Makes This Opportunity Different At IZISURF, we do not simply recruit influencers — we actively help creators grow. Our team provides strategic support in audience development, content optimization, social media analytics, trend intelligence, and creator branding. We help creators identify what content performs best, how to improve audience retention, and how to scale engagement across multiple platforms. Creators working with IZISURF may gain access to growth resources, collaboration opportunities, creator partnerships, AI‑assisted content workflows, monetization strategies, and entertainment‑related campaigns designed to increase visibility and accelerate growth. We believe that many talented creators struggle not because of creativity, but because they lack access to proper growth infrastructure. IZISURF is designed to solve that problem by combining entertainment culture expertise with modern digital growth systems. Preferred Qualifications We are looking for individuals who are highly passionate about Korean entertainment culture and actively follow K‑POP, K‑Dramas, Korean celebrities, and fandom communities. Strong communication skills, creativity, consistency, and comfort appearing on camera are highly valuable for this role. Experience with social media content creation is preferred, but we are also open to emerging creators who demonstrate strong potential, personality, and storytelling ability. Familiarity with short‑form video platforms, editing tools, and internet culture trends is important. Candidates who already maintain active social media accounts, fan communities, or entertainment‑focused content channels are strongly encouraged to apply. Korean language skills are a plus but are not required. Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is someone who genuinely enjoys talking about Korean entertainment and naturally engages with online communities. You are someone who understands internet culture, stays updated on trends, and enjoys creating content that sparks discussion and engagement. You are creative, ambitious, and interested in building a long‑term digital presence rather than simply posting occasional entertainment updates. You are excited about growing alongside a team that actively supports creator development and digital brand expansion. Most importantly, you understand fandom culture and can create content that feels authentic, relatable, and engaging to global audiences. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: K-Pop Influencers
vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para K-Pop Influencers em boa vista. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

K-POP & K-DRAMA Influencer Growth CreatorPowered by IZISURFAbout IZISURFIZISURF is building a next-generation creator growth ecosystem focused on K-POP, K-Drama, Korean entertainment, and global fan communities. Our mission is to help passionate creators transform their content into scalable global media brands through audience growth, AI-powered optimization, fan engagement strategies, and cross-platform expansion. We believe that the future of entertainment media belongs to creators who deeply understand fandom culture, digital storytelling, and internet trends. As Korean entertainment continues to influence global culture, we are creating an infrastructure that helps influencers grow faster, engage audiences more effectively, and unlock meaningful monetization opportunities. Unlike traditional influencer agencies, IZISURF operates as a creator growth partner. We actively work alongside creators to optimize content performance, identify viral opportunities, improve audience retention, and expand creator reach across multiple social media platforms. Our goal is not only to help creators gain followers, but to help them build long-term digital brands with sustainable growth. Position OverviewWe are looking for highly creative, trend-aware, and passionate K-POP & K-Drama Influencer Growth Creators who are excited about Korean entertainment culture and want to build a strong global online presence. This role is ideal for individuals who genuinely enjoy discussing K-POP groups, idols, dramas, entertainment news, fan theories, comeback analysis, performances, concerts, and online fandom culture. Whether you are already an influencer or an emerging creator with strong potential, we are interested in working with people who can create authentic and engaging content that resonates with audiences worldwide. As part of IZISURF, creators will receive strategic support designed to accelerate growth. Our team helps creators improve audience engagement, optimize content formats, analyze performance metrics, and identify viral content opportunities. We work collaboratively with creators to develop sustainable content strategies rather than focusing only on short-term trends. ResponsibilitiesThe selected creator will regularly produce engaging content related to K-POP, K-Dramas, Korean celebrities, entertainment culture, idol trends, music releases, and fan discussions. Content may include reactions, commentary, reviews, rankings, livestream discussions, entertainment analysis, short-form videos, and community engagement activities. Creators will publish content across platforms such as TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, YouTube, X (Twitter), Threads, and other emerging media channels. The role requires staying highly informed about ongoing entertainment trends, comeback schedules, drama releases, viral online discussions, and fandom activities. In addition to content production, creators will collaborate closely with the IZISURF growth team to improve visibility and engagement. This includes reviewing analytics, refining content strategy, experimenting with new content formats, and participating in cross-platform growth campaigns. We encourage creators to continuously evolve their personal brand while maintaining authenticity and strong audience connection. Creators may also participate in brand collaborations, entertainment campaigns, livestream events, fan engagement projects, and promotional activities related to Korean entertainment and digital culture. What Makes This Opportunity DifferentAt IZISURF, we do not simply recruit influencers — we actively help creators grow. Our team provides strategic support in audience development, content optimization, social media analytics, trend intelligence, and creator branding. We help creators identify what content performs best, how to improve audience retention, and how to scale engagement across multiple platforms. Creators working with IZISURF may gain access to growth resources, collaboration opportunities, creator partnerships, AI-assisted content workflows, monetization strategies, and entertainment-related campaigns designed to increase visibility and accelerate growth. We believe that many talented creators struggle not because of creativity, but because they lack access to proper growth infrastructure. IZISURF is designed to solve that problem by combining entertainment culture expertise with modern digital growth systems. Preferred QualificationsWe are looking for individuals who are highly passionate about Korean entertainment culture and actively follow K-POP, K-Dramas, Korean celebrities, and fandom communities. Strong communication skills, creativity, consistency, and comfort appearing on camera are highly valuable for this role. Experience with social media content creation is preferred, but we are also open to emerging creators who demonstrate strong potential, personality, and storytelling ability. Familiarity with short-form video platforms, editing tools, and internet culture trends is important. Candidates who already maintain active social media accounts, fan communities, or entertainment-focused content channels are strongly encouraged to apply. Korean language skills are a plus but are not required. Ideal CandidateThe ideal candidate is someone who genuinely enjoys talking about Korean entertainment and naturally engages with online communities. You are someone who understands internet culture, stays updated on trends, and enjoys creating content that sparks discussion and engagement. You are creative, ambitious, and interested in building a long-term digital presence rather than simply posting occasional entertainment updates. You are excited about growing alongside a team that actively supports creator development and digital brand expansion. Most importantly, you understand fandom culture and can create content that feels authentic, relatable, and engaging to global audiences. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Syniti’s Data First philosophy and enterprise data management platform supports data migration, data quality, data replication, data matching, master data management, analytics, data governance, and data strategy in a single, unified solution. THE ROLE The Lab Systems Architect plays a critical role in the success of Syniti’s Education Services department by designing, implementing, and maintaining technical lab environments that support both eLearning and instructor-led training. This role ensures the seamless operation of lab systems, supports integration with learning platforms, and collaborates cross-functionally to enhance system workflows and user experience. The ideal candidate is a technically skilled, detail-oriented problem solver with a passion for enabling learning through robust infrastructure. WHAT YOU WILL DO Learning Lab Architecture & Management Provide technical oversight for the design, testing, provisioning, and implementation of Learning Lab environments. Manage and maintain lab snapshots, resolving configuration defects as they arise. Optimize lab usage policies in collaboration with Education Coordinators and Leadership. Monitor VM usage reports and metrics, ensuring alignment with budget and demand. Support LMS system integrations as required. Serve as the primary escalation point for lab-related issues and liaise with solution providers to resolve complex problems across all learning lab platforms. System Administration & Support Allocate and reset user training accounts. Stay current with new feature releases across all education platforms. Provide on-call support for lab systems used in global training programs, including availability during evenings and weekends as needed. Regularly review help desk tickets to identify recurring issues, usage patterns, and knowledge gaps. Recommend targeted training, updated documentation, or additional support resources to proactively address common challenges and improve user experience. Train internal and partner instructors on lab systems. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Management Collaborate with Training Operations, Delivery Management, IT, and Application teams to improve workflows, system functionality, and user experience. Manage stakeholder expectations and requirements related to lab systems and processes. Identify and resolve cross-functional issues to ensure company-wide alignment on lab system needs. Reporting & Documentation Document system configurations, best practices, and technical procedures. Own and maintain the Education Services Revenue Report, providing monthly updates to Finance. Support the creation and maintenance of Education Services forms, lists, automations, and integrations, as required. WHAT IT TAKES Proficiency in SQL and at least one of the following databases: Oracle, MS SQL Server, IBM DB2, or MySQL. Experience managing hypervisor solutions and SaaS platform architecture. Knowledge of Microsoft Forms, Power Automate, Power BI, and SharePoint. Experience with Windows Server and Azure Active Directory. Understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). Strong technical writing and documentation skills. Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management abilities. Knowledge of GraphQL queries and mutations (preferred). Self-starter with a proactive approach to problem-solving. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Passion for education technology and continuous improvement. Be fully aligned to our core values: Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family. WHAT WE OFFER Trust in your talent. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. Support . We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone’s work is seen and valued. vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para Lead Product Designer em manaus. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life. Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing. About the role This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs. You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here. Key responsibilities Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way. Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable. Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations. Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome. Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit. Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you. Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong. Must haves 6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly. Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs. Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency. Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits. Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma. Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives. Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders. Nice to have Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar). Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms. Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar). Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique. Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Contract Review Attorney
vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Contract Review Attorney em rio branco. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

At Headshots.com, we're reimagining how professional headshots are created and delivered. Trusted by clients like Boeing, Capital One, and American Express, we transform smartphone selfies into polished, studio-quality portraits within three business days. As our enterprise client base expands across industries and geographies, including a growing footprint in regulated healthcare environments, we are building out our legal function to support that growth. We're looking for a Contract Review Attorney, reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, who will own the day-to-day review and negotiation of commercial agreements, partner closely with our business teams, and help us scale a thoughtful, risk-calibrated approach to enterprise contracting. About the Role This role combines hands-on contract review with a strategic understanding of how commercial terms translate into operational risk and opportunity. You will be the primary reviewer on incoming Master Services Agreements, Business Associate Agreements, Data Processing Addenda, Statements of Work, and vendor contracts. You will work directly with leadership to redline, negotiate, and finalize agreements that protect the company while preserving the speed and flexibility that allow us to serve enterprise clients well. We are looking for someone who brings both technical legal expertise and strong commercial judgment, someone who can identify which provisions matter, where to push, and where to accept reasonable client positions in service of getting deals closed. Key Responsibilities Lead the review and redlining of MSAs, BAAs, DPAs, SOWs, NDAs, and vendor agreements. Identify risk, draft fallback positions, and negotiate directly with client legal teams when needed. Translate complex legal terms into clear, plain-language recommendations for the business. Coordinate with the business on Standard Contractual Clauses, data transfer impact assessments, and DPA terms. Negotiate indemnification, limitation of liability, insurance requirements, IP ownership, audit rights, termination, and assignment provisions in a way that is proportionate to our scope and revenue. Develop playbooks and fallback positions so the business can move quickly on standard issues. Maintain contract templates, position playbooks, and a clause library. Work directly with sales, operations, and leadership to support active deal cycles. Translate legal positions into commercial recommendations. Provide guidance during pre-contract discussions so issues are surfaced early. Track the status of in-flight negotiations and ensure timely follow-up with client counterparties. What You Bring Experience & Qualifications Law degree (JD or LLM) from an accredited institution Six or more years of commercial contracts experience, with meaningful time spent in-house or supporting in-house teams. 5+ years of demonstrated experience reviewing and negotiating agreements (US and European commercial clients a plus) Working knowledge of GDPR and cross-border data transfer requirements. Strong command of commercial provisions: indemnification, limitation of liability, IP ownership, insurance, confidentiality, data security, termination, and assignment. Familiarity with SaaS, professional services, and vendor agreements. Excellent English skills, both written and spoken. Mindset & Strengths Commercial pragmatism. You understand that legal review serves business outcomes, and you know when to push, when to compromise, and when to escalate. Clear written communication. You can explain complex legal positions to non-lawyers in plain language and translate client redlines into clear recommendations. Calm and thorough under deadline pressure. You can manage multiple active negotiations without losing track of detail. Independent operator. You can run a contract review process end-to-end with limited supervision and know when to surface issues to leadership. Discretion and trustworthiness. You handle confidential business information with care. A no-ego collaborator. You build trust through transparent communication, take ownership of your work, and welcome feedback. Why Join Us Fully remote, flexible schedule with ET overlap. Work directly with founders and executive leadership on agreements that shape the company's growth. Opportunity to build out the legal function and contracting infrastructure at a fast-moving company. Exposure to a diverse, enterprise client base across industries and geographies. IMPORTANT Direct inquiries will disqualify candidates. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Você precisa ter: • Computador próprio com capacidade real para edição • Organização para entregar sem ser lembrado • Disponibilidade para alinhamentos com a Emilly Se você precisa de cobrança constante para produzir, essa vaga não é pra você. Três coisas — em ordem de importância: 1. Olho para conteúdo. Capacidade de assistir uma hora de vídeo e identificar os 30 segundos que prendem atenção sozinhos. 2. Constância. Entregar bem hoje, amanhã e na semana que vem. Não picos seguidos de sumiço. 3. Vontade real de crescer. Pessoa que estuda referência por conta própria, aceita feedback sem peso, aplica e volta melhor. >>>Teste prático (Passo 1) Vídeo de explicação do teste: A sua pontuação no teste terá base na qualidade e quantidade de bons cortes e conteúdos que conseguir extrair de cada vídeo longo: • Vídeos curtos de alcance em formato 16:9 (geralmente de 20 segundos até 2 minutos — topo de funil) • Vídeos médios de 2 a 7 minutos formato 16:9, mais completos e explicados, para gerar mais profundidade de relacionamento (meio e fundo de funil) • Carrosséis, tanto dos vídeos longos base, quanto dos vídeos menores FAQ: tem número de vídeos que vocês imaginam? O teste é para ver a sua capacidade de extrair o maior número de bons conteúdos e ideias possível de cada vídeo longo (vídeos menores e posts/carrosséis). P.S. Os vídeos já foram editados por nós, e essa será a régua para classificação. Vídeos longos base (extrair vídeos curtos e carrosséis): Quanto maior o número e a qualidade dos conteúdos, mais alta sua pontuação. Penalização por conteúdos ruins ou fracos. Sem encher linguiça — o que conta é volume de conteúdos bons. Critérios de avaliação: • Seleção de tema e clareza da ideia • Gancho falado — força nos 0–3s e 0–7s, curiosidade e interesse sem clickbait • Entrega de conteúdo — satisfação depois de consumir • Comunicação da marca — ética, acolhimento, evidência, linguagem simples • Velocidade e capricho — quanto mais rápido melhor, arquivos nomeados, zero ruído Referências de vídeos curtos: Envie o teste feito para: Corpo: ENVIE o Link (pasta no drive) dos conteúdos que você editou + currículo Para quem essa vaga não é • Quem quer trabalho remoto pra ficar tranquilo • Quem precisa de cobrança constante pra entregar • Quem reage a feedback como ataque • Quem quer fazer o mínimo e receber o suficiente Para quem essa vaga é • Quem está começando mas quer crescer rápido • Quem topa trabalhar duro para se provar • Quem quer entrar numa empresa que está construindo algo grande e ter a chance de crescer junto Criar um alerta de emprego para esta pesquisa #J-18808-Ljbffr

For our international customer in Valencia, we are looking for a ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer. The role focuses on ongoing APM data maintenance in ServiceNow (APM/CMDB-related records as applicable), identifying data gaps and inconsistencies, coordinating updates with application/service owners, and tracking technical debt indicators and remediation progress. EU candidates are welcome to apply. Candidates need to be based in Valencia or willing to relocate to Valencia. Candidates need to be flexible to work across time zones, including alignment with US Eastern Time where required. Work permit is not provided. Candidates need to be fluent in English. Tasks and responsibilities: Perform ongoing maintenance of Application Portfolio Management (APM) data within ServiceNow, including application inventory, ownership, lifecycle status, technology attributes, and documented integrations/dependencies, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and currency; Identify and remediate data quality issues such as missing or invalid values, duplicate records, and inconsistent classifications through coordination with application owners, service owners, and relevant stakeholders; Maintain and enhance portfolio data governance standards and controlled vocabularies, including lifecycle states, business and technical fit assessments, and application criticality classifications; Monitor and track technical debt indicators leveraging ServiceNow portfolio data, including lifecycle and obsolescence risks, unsupported technologies, architectural non-conformities, and resilience or operability gaps; Maintain a centralized log or aligned ServiceNow records documenting technical debt items, including impacted applications/services, severity and priority ratings, and recommended remediation actions such as retirement, replacement, or modernization; Develop and deliver recurring dashboards, reports, and portfolio insights for the onsite Enterprise Architect, including technical debt trends, aging remediation items, progress tracking, and portfolio risk hotspots; Translate stakeholder inputs, priorities, and publishing schedules into updates for the APM website and related communication materials; Maintain and support the APM website as a central platform for publishing portfolio data, standards, insights, lifecycle guidance, and reference information related to Application Portfolio Management practices; Profile: Master’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline; +8 years of overall experience in Information Technology; +3 years of experience supporting Enterprise Architects or working within Enterprise Architecture teams; Hands-on experience with ServiceNow, specifically supporting Application Portfolio Management (APM) data, including application and CMDB records, data validation, monitoring, maintenance, and reporting; Strong understanding of Application Portfolio Management (APM) principles, including application inventory management, lifecycle governance, business and technical fit assessments, risk and obsolescence analysis, and application rationalization strategies (retire, replace, modernize); Proven experience identifying, documenting, and tracking technical debt, including the definition of debt indicators, maintenance of remediation records, and generation of actionable reporting and insights; Solid understanding of Enterprise Architecture concepts and practices, including architecture principles, standards, governance, target-state architecture, roadmaps, and architecture deliverables, as well as the role of portfolio data in strategic decision-making; Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with distributed stakeholders to resolve data quality issues and drive timely completion of application and portfolio record updates; Previous experience delivering similar ServiceNow APM and technical debt management activities within large or complex enterprise environments is highly preferred; Strong analytical, reporting, and problem-solving capabilities, including experience producing dashboards, scorecards, KPI reporting, and trend analysis with a strong focus on data integrity and attention to detail; AI literacy, including practical experience using AI and Generative AI tools to enhance productivity in areas such as data analysis, reporting, documentation, and knowledge management, within approved enterprise governance frameworks; Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes, prepare executive-ready materials, and communicate findings effectively to Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders; Working knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks and methodologies such as TOGAF and their practical application in enterprise architecture deliverables and governance processes; Working knowledge of ServiceNow data model fundamentals relevant to Application Portfolio Management, including CMDB structures, application records, CSDM concepts, and portfolio data governance practices; Relevant certifications are considered an advantage, including: TOGAF or equivalent Enterprise Architecture certification; ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA); ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) and/or relevant ServiceNow implementation certifications related to APM or CMDB; Experience with enterprise architecture and portfolio management tooling, including ServiceNow EA Workspace and APM reporting capabilities, is considered a plus; Familiarity with responsible AI principles and the secure use of enterprise AI assistants, including prompt hygiene and protection of sensitive information, is considered an advantage; #J-18808-Ljbffr

Be a founding member of Quectel's new LATAM hub in Manaus Role Hardware Electronics Engineer – LATAM Level Mid-Level (1-3 years of experience) Type Full-Time, On-Site Languages Portuguese & English required · Spanish a plus About Quectel Quectel is one of the world's leading suppliers of cellular IoT modules, antennas, and connectivity services, with more than 4,000 professionals across 8 R&D centers and 50+ sales offices worldwide. Our technology powers everything from smart meters and connected cars to industrial robots and point-of-sale terminals — quietly enabling billions of devices to talk to the cloud. This is something special. Quectel is launching a brand-new operation in Manaus, Brazil — and we're building the founding team right now. Hosted at ICT Manaus (Instituto Centro de Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento em Tecnologia de Software), an accredited Science, Technology and Innovation Institution under SUFRAMA's CAPDA framework, this new setup will become Quectel's regional engine for R&D, customer enablement, and ANATEL certification across Latin America. Joining now means more than taking a job — it means shaping a team, a culture, and a way of working from day one. Your fingerprints will be on everything we build here. Learn more about Quectel Company website — quectel.Com LATAM in action — Furukawa Electric LatAm customer story (Brazil) Follow us on LinkedIn The Role We're hiring the founding hardware engineer for Quectel's brand-new Manaus operation. You'll be the first technical point of contact — and the technical voice — for customers across Latin America who are building tomorrow's connected products on Quectel modules: automotive telematics, smart energy, industrial IoT, connected payments, and more. Because this is a new setup, you won't be slotting into someone else's playbook. You'll define how we review designs, how we work with ANATEL labs, how we support customers, and how we train the next engineers who join the team. You'll work hands-on with hardware, sit across the table from customer engineering teams, and partner with Quectel's global R&D centers to bring solutions home for the LATAM market. "Joining a brand-new operation means you're not just doing the work — you're deciding how the work gets done. That's rare, and it's the reason engineers stay." What You'll Do Partner with LATAM customers to understand their products, then design hardware architectures and recommend the right Quectel solutions. Review schematics and PCB layouts in Altium, Cadence, or PADS — and turn your feedback into better, more reliable designs. Get hands-on at the bench: power supply analysis, signal integrity, oscilloscope work, debugging interface and certification issues. Be the trusted technical voice for our LATAM customers — answering tough questions and solving complex problems alongside our global engineering teams. Lead technical discussions with customers and certification labs, including ANATEL homologation activities. Write the application notes, design guidelines, and FAQs that help customers ship faster. Train internal FAE and Sales teams across the region — your expertise will scale across LATAM. Support the project team with BOM preparation for fast, accurate customer quotations. What You Bring Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Computer Engineering, or a related field. 3–5 years of hardware design or hardware support experience — bonus if you've worked in customer-facing or FAE roles. Solid grasp of hardware fundamentals: CPU, memory, PMU, system interfaces. Strong skills in power supply design, power sequencing, charging, and power consumption analysis. Comfortable with serial interfaces — I²C, SPI, UART, USIM — for integration and debug. Confident with bench tools: power supplies, multimeters, oscilloscopes. Hands-on with at least one EDA tool (Altium Designer, Cadence, or PADS). Fluent in English and Portuguese;Spanish is a plus. Bonus Points For Deep knowledge of USB 2.0/3.0, USB hub architecture, USB Type-C. Experience with high-speed interfaces: MIPI DSI/CSI, PCIe, SDIO. RF testing experience across cellular (2G/3G/4G/5G) and Wi‑Fi 802.11. Background in PC, mobile, server, or FWA system integration. Team leadership or technical mentoring experience. The Tech You'll Work With Quectel's full product portfolio — cellular (5G/LTE/LPWA), GNSS, smart modules, and antennas. Quectel services — including device certification work for ANATEL and other regional bodies. See it in action — Quectel customer stories from automotive, smart metering, agribusiness, and more. Why You'll Love Working Here Founding-team energy — you're not joining an established office, you're building one. The processes, the culture, the technical playbook — you'll help write it. Real impact from day one — your decisions and designs ship inside products used by millions across LATAM. Backed by a global leader — startup feel, but with the technology, customers, and resources of a 4,000-person publicly-listed IoT company behind you. Direct line to global R&D — work side-by-side with our R&D centers in China, Europe, and North America while staying rooted in Manaus's growing tech ecosystem. Cutting-edge technology — 5G, LPWA, AI at the edge, smart camera modules, and the next generation of connected devices. Career growth on a fast curve — early team members typically grow into senior technical or leadership roles as the operation scales. Customer-facing exposure — directly shape how leading LATAM brands build their connected products. Competitive package — attractive compensation, benefits, and the stability of a global market leader. Competitive base salary aligned with LATAM market benchmarks. Flexible meal and grocery vouchers (meal allowance / food allowance). Health insurance with no co-pay. Life insurance. Paid time off. International travel opportunities — HQ visits and global trade shows. Ready to Apply? If this sounds like your kind of challenge, we'd love to hear from you. Send your CV (in English) along with a short note about what excites you most about the role. We review applications on a rolling basis. Apply via: | Browse open roles: quectel.Com/recruitment Quectel is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive team where everyone can do their best work. Hardware Engineer • manaus, federative republic of brazil, Brazil #J-18808-Ljbffr

You’ve worked with enterprise customers, dealt with messy data, conflicting sources of truth, and deduplication challenges. You’ve owned integration design decisions end-to-end — from scoping requirements with a customer to shipping it to production and making sure it holds up. You may be coming from a health tech company, a scale-up doing enterprise deployments, or a platform team that built the connective tissue between systems — what matters is that you’ve navigated real integration complexity and you want ownership over what you build. About the Role Members of Technical Staff (Deployments) at Anterior own customer deployment problems end-to-end — from scoping integrations through to production. You’ll be the bridge between our AI platform and the enterprise healthcare systems it plugs into. A day’s work may include: Designing and building integrations, APIs, and data pipelines that connect our platform to customer systems of record EHRs, claims platforms, care management systems) Working directly with US enterprise healthcare customers to understand their architecture, scope integration requirements, and translate them into technical specs Building and maintaining FHIR, HL7, and A equipe de Engenharia de Manutenção e Confiabilidade (Reliability Maintenance Engineering - RME) na Amazon é fundamental para nossas operações - são eles que mantêm maquinários vitais funcionando o tempo todo. Como Técnico de RME, você fará a manutenção de uma ampla gama de equipamentos e espaços de trabalho, ao mesmo tempo em que mantém as melhores práticas de Saúde e Segurança. Você ajudará a manter seus colegas seguros e prevenir o tempo de inatividade das máquinas. Nossos Técnicos de RME aumentam a disponibilidade e qualidade de nossos equipamentos e também trabalham para melhorar o ambiente operacional. Manter todas as políticas e práticas de saúde e segurança. Apoiar o desenvolvimento e a progressão de aprendizes no local. Trabalhar em projetos de melhoria contínua e implementar as melhores práticas em diversos sites do Brasil. Acordo de Trabalho Nossos Técnicos de RME estão baseados no site, para que possam responder rapidamente a quaisquer problemas com maquinários.
