vagas.title: Ai implementation lead (technical pm for agents & agentic / automated systems)
vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Ai implementation lead (technical pm for agents & agentic / automated systems) em palmas. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Zaigo builds custom AI systems for founder-led, middle-market companies — the kind of businesses with messy operations, real revenue, and legacy software in place. They are thinking about how to leverage AI but don't know where to start. We turn manual workflows and inefficiencies into production AI systems, fast. We are hiring an AI Implementation Lead to own client delivery end-to-end inside a pod structure. You will run 5–10 client accounts at once, with 2–3 senior AI engineers reporting into your pod, and you will be the person the client trusts to get things shipped. Think of this as a principal-level role at a consulting firm: a senior partner sets the strategy and owns the relationship at the top, you own the execution and the day-to-day client trust, and your engineers do the heavy build. You are the person who keeps everything moving, makes the calls, and ships. What you'll actually do Own the client. You'll run discovery calls, scope the work, set expectations, give status updates, manage scope creep, and be the steady hand the client calls when something is on fire. Many of our clients are non-technical executives running real businesses — you need to be able to translate \"we have this messy thing happening in our operations\" into a concrete AI system, in plain English, without jargon. Architect the solution. On a discovery call, you should be able to sketch out a working solution in real time: \"Okay, this is a RAG problem with a chat layer on top, we'll use these 5 specialized agents to handle X, Y, and Z, output formatted to your Excel template, and we'll integrate with your existing CRM via API calls.\" You don't need to write the production code, but you need to know enough to confidently scope it, pick the right framework, point to the right open-source repo, and know roughly what's hard vs. easy. Run the pod. Translate the scoped solution into engineering tasks, hand it off cleanly, unblock the engineers, and review the work. You can't read every line of AI-generated code — nobody can anymore. You're evaluating whether the output is directionally right, whether the UX makes sense, whether the architecture will hold up, and whether it actually solves the client's problem. Strong product intuition matters more than line-by-line review. Prototype when needed. You're a player-coach. You should be comfortable opening Cursor or Claude Code to validate an approach, build a quick demo for a client call, or prototype a tricky workflow before handing it to engineers. You're not shipping production code as your main job, but you can build. Juggle. You'll have ~10 active projects across 5–10 clients at any time. Deadlines slip, priorities shift, clients change their minds. You stay calm, communicate proactively, and keep everything moving. Who you are You have at least 5–8 years of experience in some combination of technical product management, solutions engineering, technical consulting, forward-deployed engineering, or running your own thing. You may have been a founder. You may have been a PM at a fast company who got tired of waiting for engineers and started vibe coding your own stuff. You're technically literate in a hands-on way: you can vibe code, you know the major agentic frameworks (Claude Agent SDK, Vercel AI SDK etc.), you understand RAG architectures, you know when to use a vector DB vs. a graph DB vs. just dumping things into context, you've shipped things using AI tools. You communicate exceptionally well in English, both written and verbal. You're comfortable on a Zoom call with a 62-year-old CEO who has never heard of Loom and explaining to him, patiently, what we're building and why it matters for his business. You have founder-grade ownership. You don't say \"that wasn't in the ticket.\" You don't wait for someone to tell you what to do next. You see the gap, you close it. This role is for you if You can take a messy business problem and produce a clear, shippable architecture for it within a single call. You like running a lot of things at once and you don't drop balls. You're excited about AI-assisted building and you use these tools every day already. You want to work alongside experienced founders and senior engineers, with real ownership and real client exposure, in a fast-growing company. This role is not for you if You want to write production code all day. You're a pure project manager who needs a PRD and a Jira board to function. You're uncomfortable on the phone with non-technical executives. You need a manager to tell you what to prioritize this week. You avoid ambiguity. Location Fully remote. We're focused on candidates based in Brazil with strong daily overlap with U. S. Eastern Time. How to apply To apply, please email (not DM) the following directly to and copy : Your resume A short Loom video (5–10 minutes max, must be a Loom link) walking us through one technical or operational project you personally owned In the Loom, cover: The business problem you were solving Your specific role The technical workflow or architecture at a high level The biggest challenge you solved How you organized and managed delivery We strongly prefer candidates who can explain complex technical systems clearly, concisely, and in plain English. Applications without a Loom video will not be considered.

vagas.title: Software engineer
vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Software engineer em manaus. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Software Engineer-SMART MODULE Founding smart-module engineer at Quectel's new Manaus hub Location Manaus, Amazonas, Brazil Role Software Engineer – Smart Module – LATAM Level Mid-Level (3–5 years of experience) Type Full-Time, On-Site Languages Portuguese & English required · Spanish a plus About Quectel Quectel is one of the world's leading suppliers of cellular Io T modules, antennas, and connectivity services, with more than 4,000 professionals across 8 R& D centers and 50+ sales offices worldwide. Our technology powers everything from smart meters and connected cars to industrial robots and point-of-sale terminals — quietly enabling billions of devices to talk to the cloud. A New Chapter: Quectel in Manaus This is something special. Quectel is launching a brand-new operation in Manaus, Brazil — and we're building the founding team right now. Hosted at ICT Manaus (Instituto Centro de Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento em Tecnologia de Software), an accredited Science, Technology and Innovation Institution under SUFRAMA's CAPDA framework, this new setup will become Quectel's regional engine for R& D, customer enablement, and ANATEL certification across Latin America. Joining now means more than taking a job — it means shaping a team, a culture, and a way of working from day one. Your fingerprints will be on everything we build here. Learn more about Quectel: Company website — quectel. Com Our history & global footprint — quectel. Com/company/history LATAM in action — Furukawa Electric Lat Am customer story (Brazil) Follow us on Linked In The Role Smart modules are where Quectel's cellular tech meets serious compute — Android and Linux platforms with camera, multimedia, and AI capabilities, powering everything from smart POS terminals to AI vision devices and connected industrial equipment. This is a founding-team role at Quectel's brand-new Manaus operation. You'll own the smart-module software story for the LATAM region: drivers, peripheral bring-up, multimedia and camera frameworks, and the customer-facing engineering work that turns Quectel modules into shipping products. Because the team is being built from scratch, you'll help define the technical playbook, the customer engagement model, and the way smart-module work happens here. "Smart modules let you touch the whole stack — kernel drivers, camera HAL, all the way up to Android apps. Doing that as part of a founding team, where you shape how things get built? Even better." What You'll Do Own software development and maintenance for assigned LATAM customer projects on Quectel smart modules. Design and develop camera algorithms — image processing, enhancement, optimization. Bring up and integrate camera and image processing features into customer applications. Run camera testing and tuning across lighting conditions to deliver great image quality. Debug peripheral bring-up issues: MIPI LCD, sensors, MIPI camera, audio/video codecs. Support LATAM customers: develop new SW features, debug their issues, improve the SW stack and demo applications. Collaborate with overseas R& D teams — platform, hardware, FAEs, project managers, QA. Document what you build: design specs, technical analysis reports, knowledge articles. Write clean, scalable, efficient code — and improve the code that's already there. What You Bring Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. 3–5 years of embedded software experience on Android and/or Linux platforms. Strong C, C++, and Java programming skills. Solid Linux internals and system programming knowledge; RTOS exposure is a plus. Experience with the embedded software development lifecycle. Hands-on experience with Android applications, HAL, and multimedia frameworks (GStreamer, Cam X, Open CV, Open GL). Linux device driver development and peripheral bring-up experience (MIPI LCD, sensors, MIPI camera, audio/video codecs). Comfort with hardware/software integration and debugging. Day-to-day experience with Git and Agile workflows. Strong problem-solving skills and customer-friendly communication. Fluent in English and Portuguese; Spanish is a plus. Bonus Points For AI / machine learning experience for image analysis. Familiarity with Qualcomm camera frameworks (Cam X / Chi-CDK). Prior FAE or customer-engineering experience in the LATAM region. The Tech You'll Work With Quectel's smart module portfolio — Android, Linux, and Yocto-based platforms supporting cameras, displays, audio, GNSS, Wi-Fi/BT, and 5 G. Read the deep-dive: "What is a smart module?" by a Quectel product manager. Qualcomm camera frameworks (Cam X/Chi-CDK), GStreamer, Open CV, Open GL, and AI/ML at the edge. Why You'll Love Working Here Founding-team energy — you're not joining an established office, you're building one. The processes, the culture, the technical playbook — you'll help write it. Real impact from day one — your decisions and designs ship inside products used by millions across LATAM. Backed by a global leader — startup feel, but with the technology, customers, and resources of a 4,000-person publicly-listed Io T company behind you. Direct line to global R& D — work side-by-side with our R& D centers in China, Europe, and North America while staying rooted in Manaus's growing tech ecosystem. Cutting-edge technology — 5 G, LPWA, AI at the edge, smart camera modules, and the next generation of connected devices. Career growth on a fast curve — early team members typically grow into senior technical or leadership roles as the operation scales. Customer-facing exposure — directly shape how leading LATAM brands build their connected products. Competitive package — attractive compensation, benefits, and the stability of a global market leader. Compensation & Benefits Competitive base salary aligned with LATAM market benchmarks. Performance bonus / sales commission structure (role dependent). Flexible meal and grocery vouchers (meal allowance / food allowance). Health insurance with no co-pay. Life insurance. Paid time off. International travel opportunities — HQ visits and global trade shows. Ready to Apply? If this sounds like your kind of challenge, we'd love to hear from you. Send your CV (in English) along with a short note about what excites you most about the role. We review applications on a rolling basis. Apply via: sasha.saini@ | Browse open roles: quectel. Com/recruitment Quectel is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive team where everyone can do their best work.

You'll define how we review designs, how we work with ANATEL labs, how we support customers, and how we train the next engineers who join the team. "Joining a brand-new operation means you're not just doing the work — you're deciding how the work gets done. That's rare, and it's the reason engineers stay." Review schematics and PCB layouts in Altium, Cadence, or PADS — and turn your feedback into better, more reliable designs. Get hands-on at the bench: power supply analysis, signal integrity, oscilloscope work, debugging interface and certification issues. Be the trusted technical voice for our LATAM customers — answering tough questions and solving complex problems alongside our global engineering teams. Lead technical discussions with customers and certification labs, including ANATEL homologation activities. Write the application notes, design guidelines, and FAQs that help customers ship faster. Train internal FAE and Sales teams across the region — your expertise will scale across LATAM. Support the project team with BOM preparation for fast, accurate customer quotations. Solid grasp of hardware fundamentals: CPU, memory, PMU, system interfaces. Strong skills in power supply design, power sequencing, charging, and power consumption analysis. Comfortable with serial interfaces — I2 C, SPI, UART, USIM — for integration and debug. Confident with bench tools: power supplies, multimeters, oscilloscopes. Hands-on with at least one EDA tool (Altium Designer, Cadence, or PADS). Fluent in English and Portuguese; Spanish is a plus. Bonus Points For Experience designing PCBA end-to-end. Deep knowledge of USB 2.0/3.0, USB hub architecture, USB Type-C. Experience with high-speed interfaces: MIPI DSI/CSI, PCIe, SDIO. RF testing experience across cellular (2 G/3 G/4 G/5 G) and Wi-Fi 802.11. Background in PC, mobile, server, or FWA system integration. Prior ANATEL homologation experience. Team leadership or technical mentoring experience. The Tech You'll Work With Quectel's full product portfolio — cellular (5 G/LTE/LPWA), GNSS, smart modules, and antennas. Quectel services — including device certification work for ANATEL and other regional bodies. See it in action — Quectel customer stories from automotive, smart metering, agribusiness, and more. Career growth on a fast curve — early team members typically grow into senior technical or leadership roles as the operation scales. vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Ai development orchestrator em boa vista. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Location: Remote Type: Full-Time Reports to: CEO Stack: Type Script, Python, React (Next.js App Router), Node, Postgre SQL, Supabase (Auth + RLS + Edge Functions + Realtime + Storage), Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Anthropic SDK, MCP, Bash, Git Stage: Revenue-generating Saa S, active production users Start: Immediate The Company Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values innovative solutions and creativity. With a commitment to excellence and collaboration, the company provides comprehensive services tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential. We are currently hiring for a partner company that is the operating system for founders building personal brands. They help B2 B founders turn expertise into organic content engines that generate revenue without ads, agencies, or 10-hour content days. They have served 18,000+ founders and built a $15 M/year business on organic content alone. They are now building the platform that powers our done-for-you delivery at scale. The Role You are the engineering quality gate. You direct AI agents through focused task briefs, review every commit, and catch what the AI misses. You think in systems; the agents think in code. Multiple LLMs are run against the same problem; the strongest output is selected. Your job is to ensure what ships is correct, secure, performant, and architecturally sound. Every uncertain decision goes through structured review before approval. The validation layer is non-negotiable. What You Do Review every AI-generated commit. Not \"does it run\" - \"what happens under concurrent load, what happens when an edge function cold-starts, what RLS policy is silently leaking across tenants.\" Architect features as single-task agent briefs: What / Why / Done When / Watch Out For. Scoped, focused, clear. Own the test pipeline. Vitest unit + Deno tests for edge functions + Playwright E2 E. Evaluate whether tests prove behavior or inflate coverage. Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent. Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix. Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites. Must-Haves Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer; the AI is the author. Supabase in production. Postgre SQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant. Type Script primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems. React in production. Next.js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns. Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it. Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, Hub Spot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down. Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations. Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role. Strong Signals Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison. Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code). Database-level access control in production. Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or Web Sockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling. OWASP Top 10 fluency. Product Saa S background, not agency or consultancy. Red Flags AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you. Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance. Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify. Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review. Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack. Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership. No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications. Who This Person Is 3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward Type Script + Supabase (or equivalent Postgre SQL stack) and Python comfort. Descrição da vaga ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história. A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes. Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país. E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras. Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades. Responsabilidades e atribuições Supervisionar as equipes de Vigilantes, Bombeiros Civis e Operadores de CFTV assegurando o cumprimento das rotinas operacionais e padrões estabelecidos; Apoiar o Coordenador de Segurança nas atividades diárias do departamento; Realizar o registro, controle e acompanhamento de ocorrências e sinistros; Atuar na gestão de crises e incidentes, garantindo resposta rápida e adequada às situações; Elaborar relatórios diários e indicadores da área; Controlar e organizar documentos pertinentes à operação de segurança; Multiplicar treinamentos operacionais e reforçar procedimentos junto às equipes; Garantir o cumprimento das normas internas, atuando como referência para a equipe e clientes; Prestar atendimento a clientes, lojistas e colaboradores em temas relacionados à segurança; Apoiar na gestão e fiscalização da empresa de segurança terceirizada, assegurando aderência contratual e qualidade na prestação do serviço. Requisitos e qualificações Graduação em áreas gestão de pessoas, administração ou áreas afins; Ter conhecimento na área de segurança patrimonial, equipamentos de segurança, atendimento ao público, inclusão e diversidade e na área de facilites, será um diferencial; Conhecimento no pacote office (word, Excel, Power point); Experiência em gestão de equipes.
